messages:
lucy: Quick heads-up — we just saw a small cluster of users get charged twice for very short SSE sessions (~1–3s). Console shows an immediate +charge and then a refund a few seconds later, but metrics still count the first charge toward tenant quota.

nate: Ugh. Any correlation with proxy 204 / early EOFs? I vaguely remember 204 paths can cause client to immediately re-open stream.

lucy: Logs look like rapid socket close -> client reconnect pattern. Example trace: 
```
2026-03-20T15:02:11Z socket-close session=tok_abc123 reason=client:idle
2026-03-20T15:02:12Z new-stream accept session=tok_abc123 route=rr-shard-7
2026-03-20T15:02:12Z billing:charge tenant=acme token=tok_abc123 amount=0.0002
2026-03-20T15:02:13Z socket-close session=tok_abc123 reason=proxy:204
2026-03-20T15:02:14Z new-stream accept session=tok_abc123 route=rr-shard-3
2026-03-20T15:02:14Z billing:charge tenant=acme token=tok_abc123 amount=0.0002
2026-03-20T15:02:16Z billing:refund tenant=acme token=tok_abc123 amount=0.0002
```

maya: Noticed two relevant things: (1) our routing is pure round-robin for short sessions so resume lands on different shard; (2) console quota accounting counts the initial charge immediately and only applies refund later. Combined they look like double-count streaks.

diego: Methods to mitigate: server-side dedupe window on resume-token (5–10s), OR sticky routing for recent sessions, OR only count charge when session is acknowledged by serving runtime. Dedupe seems easiest short-term.

sam: Can repro locally with a simple looped client. Example: 
```
while true; do 
  curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/stream?samples=1
  sleep 1
done
```
This generates the same pattern in dev env.

lucy: Agreed we should do a quick patch: 1) add server-side idempotency for billing events keyed by (tenant, resume-token, recent-window) 2) add console flag to mark refunded charges so quota displays as net by default.

nate: Small UX ask — when refund occurs, can console surface an annotation on the tenant quota timeline (e.g., greyed reversed point) + link to the raw billing event? Right now ops keeps pinging us.

console-bot: Filed UI ticket #INF-892: "Show net quota after refunds + refund annotations" — assigned to @maya.

maya: I'll pick up the console change. For runtime patch I'll pair with @diego tomorrow to add the 7s dedupe window in the charge emitter. Can we ship a canary to dedicated first?

diego: Yes. Plan: implement dedupe in billing-emitter (idempotency cache TTL 7s), add metric `billing.duplicate_detected` with tag route/shard, and flag for sticky routing experiment. I'll open PR and request review.

infra-bot: Alert: sampling link https://console.redwood.dev/playground/trace/xyz123 (sampled traces attached)

sam: Also let's add an opt-in router flag `sticky_short_sessions=true` that product can enable per-tenant while we evaluate cost impact.

lucy: Sounds good. Action items: diego PR for dedupe + metric, maya UI ticket, natel (?) — nate to triage alerts and add runbook note. We'll monitor duplicate_detected over next 48h.

nate: on it. I'll add runbook step and set an alert at 5 duplicates/min for immediate paging. :+1:

lucy: Thanks — will follow up with postmortem if we see more than 10 tenants affected.
